$description: Canonical design tokens for the event4u agent tooling — ONE source consumed by two independent GUIs via build-time generators: agent-config's Preact settings GUI (build-ac.mjs → src/ui/tokens.css, hex CSS vars, W3C draft names) and agent-switch's React/Tailwind/shadcn GUI (build-as.mjs → shadcn :root block, HSL channels). Homed in agent-config: it owns the W3C-draft naming and the more complete surface ladder; a third repo was rejected for a two-consumer problem (roadmap decision). W3C Design Tokens draft shape, canonical values in hex/rgba. `_version` is bumped on ANY value change — a token change is a visual breaking change for the embedded view; the embed provenance strip may surface a host/AC token-version mismatch. Accent family: event4u orange (brand #d15c38, hue 14 / sat 62) with per-theme surface-adjusted lightness so every text role clears WCAG AA on every surface step — measured derivation in tokens/s0.1-contrast-verdict.md. Council convergence 2026-07-27 (claude-sonnet-4-5 + gpt-4o, 2 rounds): one shared warning (AC amber), one shared ladder (AC near-black + sidebar step), light sidebar reuses an existing step instead of inventing a fifth value.

orange.$description: The literal event4u brand orange. Reference/identity value — GUIs render the per-theme derived accents below; soft tints keep this literal RGB.

sidebar.$description: Sidebar chrome step above surface-hover — added for agent-switch's setup-hub redesign; unused by agent-config's own chrome today.

accent.$description: Brand orange +5 L — AA (>= 4.5) as text on all FIVE dark surface steps incl. sidebar #232427 (worst 4.55); the literal #d15c38 fails on surface-alt/surface-hover, and +4 L still fails on sidebar.

accent-fg.$description: Text on accent fills — 5.38:1 on accent, 6.45:1 on accent-hover.

accent-soft.$description: Brand-literal tint. Constraint: accent-colored text on a soft chip only on bg/surface — the compound blend on elevated surfaces drops below AA (s0.1-contrast-verdict.md).

focus-ring.$description: = accent-hover (existing dark pattern); >= 3:1 vs every adjacent surface.

sidebar.$description: Reuses surface-alt (resting chrome surface) — council: reuse an existing step, do not invent a fifth light value.

accent.$description: Brand orange -9 L — AA (>= 4.5) as text on all four light surface steps; the literal fails on every light surface (3.54-3.96).

accent-fg.$description: White on darkened orange — 5.42:1 on accent, 6.58:1 on accent-hover.

accent-soft.$description: Brand-literal tint. Same elevated-surface constraint as dark.

focus-ring.$description: Brand -6 L; >= 3:1 vs every adjacent light surface.
